profile.headline: Specialist Software Engineer at ubank
profile.summary:
I recently finished my Master of Engineering in Electrical Engineering at the Electrical and Electronics Engineering Institute of the University of the Philippines with focus on mobile networks.

I work with Nokia for the past four-a-half years starting as a Software Developer and working my way up to Software Architect. During my stay, I was part of both design and implementation of new features in telecommunication systems deployed all over the world with focus on high throughput, quality, resilience and compliance to 3GPP specifications. I was also involved with different proof-of-concept implementations and improvement of internal tools. Here, Java, C++ and Python is mainly used.

Being surrounded with really cool and amazing people since college, I always look forward of trying new technologies ranging from responsive web design, cloud computing, novel database system, and emerging software design concepts. I am comfortable with Linux and open-source software with git as my preferred choice of version control.

positions.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Team Lead
positions.description:
SuperChoice is the dominant leader in providing clearing house solutions for the Australian superannuation marketplace. Around 100,000 employers, including two-thirds of all companies with more than 200 employees, use our platform to pay almost 40 million SuperStream compliant contributions per annum (worth ~$25 billion) on behalf of around 2.3 million employees.

I was originally recruited to join a small team that worked on client development team that works on a large microservices-based ecosystem (100+ applications). The core technology stack consists of Java 8 / 11, the Springboot framework, Elasticsearch, Docker, PostgreSQL, and RESTful web services and mainly focuses on different integration with our clients (Employers, Super Funds and their administrators, Life Insurers, Payroll Solution Providers, Accounting Software Providers) and the Australian Taxation Office.

positions.locationName: Metro Manila, National Capital Region, Philippines

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
Nokia is a global leader in the technologies that connect people and things ranging from mobile and fixed broadband, IP routing and optical networks. It is serving customers in over 100 countries across the world.

Research and Development in 4G Mobile Networks

* Coordinated with the System Architect and other Software Architects from different functional areas so that interaction with different modules are well defined

* Participated during the Feasibility studies and design of Requirement specifications of features

* Oversaw major refactoring efforts and changes in module architecture

* Responsible for the feature software design and implementation

* Reviewed implementation of features related to the Protocols subarea.

positions.title: Software Development 2
positions.description:
Research and Development in 4G Mobile Networks

* Technical Lead of Diameter Team which support the development teams in their work. The Diameter Team is responsible for the the managing SCTP and UDP connections and provides encode/decode capability between MME and other core network elements in the LTE network.

* Introduced a number of internal technical improvements and innovations which cause significant increase in code coverage, and increased development speed.

* Configured the local Continuous Integration server (Jenkins) to emulate the Official CI pipeline so that we can incorporate Static Code Analysis, Valgrind Memory Checks and Code Coverage. Because of this, we are able to improve code quality using these metrics.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Metro Manila, National Capital Region, Philippines
positions.description:
Research and Development in 4G Mobile Networks

* Participated in the development of proof-of-concepts and improvement of different internal tools. Implemented a graphical alternative to the man-machine language (MML) console.

* Developed using Java as the primary language in a Windows environment

* Introduced automated UI testing in one of the internal tools

* Explored current technologies such as unit testing, continuous integration, distributed version control systems and database.

Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering

projects.title: Python Messaging Gateway based on Web2py
projects.description: A project sponsored by the UP Manila National Telehealth Center that aims to provide an online telereferral system that helps rural-based physicians refer complex cases to the clinical specialists. It is written in Python using Web2py.

projects.title: Traffic Aware Alarm
projects.description: Created an android app where a user sets an alarm and the system intelligently adjusts it based on the traffic to the user's destination.
